lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: On an isolated Debug emulator build with diagnosticDeliveryChecks and use DiagnosticsTestRunner with an explicit test DSN pointing to an unavailable loopback receiver.
Invoke DiagnosticsNoiseTest seedObsoleteEndpointAndLargeLocalBacklog, stop only the emulator Debug process and separately invoke coldStartRetainsBacklogAndDelegatingHandlerWithoutRemoteUpload.

Invoke sdkBeforeSendPersistsAddressAndOneHttpEventPerBurst and actualSdkHttpCaptureRetainsOriginalRequestAndResponse on fresh synthetic caches; rerun workerRetriesTemporaryServerFailureWithoutNetworkChange with its loopback DSN.
Invoke androidJsonHashKeepsSnapshotDownloadAndStagedFormConsistent with synthetic forms to exercise the actual Android JSON implementation.
value.expected: 6000 synthetic log rows survive cold startup without an upload URL or repeated initialization; app format and delegating handler remain. Twenty-eight same-source 503 events produce one envelope retaining its address and a different source another. Actual SDK capture keeps original query/headers/response, while receiver 503 retry succeeds without reinstalling handlers. Never run this on a physical device.
